notes.title: Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hey guys, today we are glad to represent you demo-version of our game R.E.E.L.!
R.E.E.L. is a game for everyone who wants to find out how electronics stuff works.
Play the R.E.E.L. and step by step you will know:

 What is inside your computer
 How micro schemes  work
 Find out real electronic components
 Have fun and relax solving interesting puzzles

Learn and have fun!
